chunks: And the Commander of the Faithful, peace be upon him, said:
The two prostrations of forgetfulness are after the taslim and before speaking.

key_terms.السَّهْوِ: forgetfulness or inadvertent lapse in prayer

ai.seo_question: When are the two prostrations of forgetfulness performed in salat?
ai.summary: This hadith states the legal placement of Sajdatā al-Sahw in salat. It teaches that the two prostrations for forgetfulness are to be performed after the taslim and before any speech.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.994 - The Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:
"The two prostrations of forgetfulness (Sajdah al-Sahw) are after the Tasleem (salutation) and before speaking."
